name: Tamam
description: Family-style Greek cooking with Ottoman and wider Eastern Mediterranean influences, served in a former bathhouse near the old harbour.

name: Gramboussa Restaurant
description: A village restaurant known for generous Cretan dishes, home-grown ingredients and a leafy courtyard near the Balos route. The venue does not take reservations.

name: Pallas
description: An all-day waterfront address for breakfast through dinner, with a broad drinks list and views across Chania’s Venetian harbour.

name: Dounias
description: A destination taverna where seasonal produce and meat are cooked over wood fires in a mountain village setting.

name: Kross Coffee Roasters
description: Chania-based roasters serving carefully sourced coffees across several city shops, with pastries and an easy neighbourhood feel.

name: Salis
description: A seasonal kitchen on the harbour working closely with Cretan growers, backed by a notably deep Greek and international wine list.

name: EnLefko
description: A small south-coast dining room focused on fresh fish, seafood and Greek wines. Ask what landed that day and reserve in high season.

name: Ginger Concept
description: A design-conscious Chania bistro serving brunch, light Mediterranean plates, wine and cocktails in a lofty former industrial space with a back terrace.

name: Fagotto Jazz Bar
description: A small, long-running bar on the harbour steps with jazz, swing and blues, an intimate atmosphere and occasional live sets.

name: Sinagogi Bar
description: A seasonal open-air cocktail bar set within atmospheric stone ruins in the old town, known for music-led nights and drinks under the sky.

name: Avli
description: Refined Cretan cooking in the courtyard of a restored Venetian-era residence, supported by an extensive cellar and local pantry.

name: Ali Vafi’s Garden
description: Coffee, food and cocktails unfold through the day in a green courtyard set within a historic old-town building.

name: Bricks Beers & Tales
description: A relaxed seafront beer house pouring independent Cretan and Greek brews alongside international taps and cocktails.

name: Kastro Cretan Cuisine
description: Traditional island flavours presented with a modern hand in Panormos, with a full drinks and cocktail menu.

name: Alpha Omega
description: A family-run Plakias restaurant combining Cretan recipes and local ingredients with a contemporary seaside approach.

name: Cavo
description: A seafront restaurant and bar with a substantial signature-cocktail list, best suited to sunset drinks that can stretch into dinner.

name: 1600 Raki BaRaki
description: A relaxed sister venue to Avli serving seasonal Cretan meze, local wines, raki and ingredient-led cocktails in the old town.

name: Prima Plora
description: An organic-focused waterfront restaurant west of the centre, pairing seafood and contemporary Mediterranean cooking with Fortezza and sunset views.

name: Hasika
description: A chef-led old-town restaurant built around carefully sourced Greek ingredients, with an adjacent bar designed to pair cocktails with the kitchen.

name: Sirtaki Tavern
description: A three-generation family taverna for home-style Cretan dishes, grilled meats and warm service. Its official site reports a 4.9 Google score from more than 1,500 reviews.

name: Taverna 1930
description: A backstreet old-village taverna praised for slow-cooked and grilled meats. Its current Google listing is reported at 4.8 from roughly 1,000 reviews, so book in busy weeks.

name: Myrtios Traditional Taverna
description: A long-running family taverna in the old village square using Cretan ingredients for oven dishes, seafood and antikristo. The large Google review base makes it a dependable atmosphere-first choice.

name: Taverna Me…Raki
description: A traditional taverna on the inland road toward Kastelli, cooking with fresh produce and olive oil. Its reported 4.9 Google score is backed by more than 840 reviews.

name: Blue Label Bar
description: A small, unfussy waterfront bar whose drinks and friendly service matter more than elaborate décor. It currently carries a reported 4.9 Google score from over 100 reviews.

name: Kafenedaki
description: A small family-run bar near Anissaras beach with a deliberately relaxed atmosphere, cocktails, coffee and snacks. Its 5.0 reported Google score is supported by more than 125 reviews.

name: King Scorpio Beach Club
description: A large all-day beach club spanning two small coves, with sunbeds, a restaurant and cocktail bar. Its 4.5 Google score has unusually strong volume at roughly 3,900 reviews.

name: Peskesi
description: A polished exploration of Cretan food using produce from the restaurant’s own organic farm and recipes rooted in island tradition.

name: Jasmine
description: A city-centre all-day venue pairing modern Mediterranean plates and breakfast with a dedicated handcrafted cocktail programme.

name: Apiri Greek Eatery
description: A contemporary Greek kitchen that reworks familiar flavours with polished technique, seasonal produce and a concise, modern dining-room feel.

name: Erganos
description: A long-standing local taverna for dishes such as lamb, snails, pies and wedding-style rice, served with a more traditional feel than the city-centre bistros.

name: Pagopoieion
description: An all-day landmark in a converted ice factory, combining food and drinks with exhibitions, readings, concerts and one of the centre’s best squares.

name: Ferryman
description: A long-running waterfront restaurant in Elounda serving Cretan and Mediterranean dishes with direct views across Mirabello Bay.

name: Piato
description: A family restaurant operating since 1980, evolving Cretan and Greek flavours through seasonal ingredients and a substantial all-Greek wine cellar.

name: Pelagos Sea Side Restaurant
description: A seaside dining room centred on fish, seafood and Mediterranean dishes, suited to a leisurely meal near Agios Nikolaos.

name: Gioma Meze
description: A popular lakefront meze restaurant serving fresh fish, grilled dishes and Greek wine; reserve in summer if you want one of the best-view tables.
